action.message: For Cockcroft–Gault/Wright dosing, verify creatinine sampled within 48 hours and recalculate as required each cycle before administering carboplatin. Missing timing does not prove freshness.

action.message: Current creatinine exceeds 110% of the value at isotope GFR. Consider remeasuring GFR or recalculating by Cockcroft–Gault/Wright before carrying forward the dose; no automatic dose is provided.

action.message: Compare current creatinine with the value at isotope GFR before retaining the previous dose. Missing comparison does not establish stability.

action.message: Measured GFR is preferred when obesity or low serum creatinine makes an estimate unreliable. Confirm weight and creatinine method; do not silently apply an adjustment or creatinine floor.

action.message: Cap absolute GFR at 125 mL/min in the Calvert calculation. Verify the renal value and prescribed dose; do not calculate from an uncapped higher GFR.

eligibility: Locally advanced head and neck squamous cell cancer when cisplatin-based treatment is unsuitable.
exclusions: Relevant medicine hypersensitivity; check the current NCCP source and component-specific assessment rules.
Baseline ANC <1.5 ×10⁹/L, platelets <100 ×10⁹/L, bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN or known complete DPD deficiency.
